component.name: Antigravity Vault
component.summary: High-assurance zero-knowledge personal password generator and encrypted vault

description.p: Antigravity Vault is an ultra-secure, memory-hygienic personal password generator and encrypted vault built with Rust Stable and Flutter.

ul.li: Automatic memory zeroization on drop and lock
Offline Emergency Recovery Kit and authenticated .vaultbak backups
Multi-format import from Bitwarden, 1Password, KeePass, and RFC 4180 CSV
